statements.t: On September 12, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive equity and asset purchase agreement to acquire the personal care division of AccentCare, Inc. for an anticipated purchase price, after customary purchase price adjustments, of approximately $275.0 million.

The Company expects to close the AccentCare Acquisition following completion of regulatory approvals and subject to customary closing conditions and to fund it through a combination of the Company’s revolver and cash on hand.

Our business will benefit from the rate increases noted above for 2026, but there is no assurance that there will be additional rate increases in Illinois in future fiscal years to offset increases in minimum wage, and our financial performance will be adversely impacted for any periods in which an additional offsetting reimbursement rate increase is not in effect.

Although we believe our liquidity position remains strong, we can provide no assurance that we will remain in compliance with the covenants in our Credit Agreement, and in the future, it may prove necessary to seek an amendment with the bank lending group under our credit facility.
Additionally, there can be no assurance that we will be able to raise additional funds on terms acceptable to us, if at all.

statements.t: On September 14, 2026, the Company announced a definitive agreement to acquire the personal care division of AccentCare for an anticipated purchase price, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, of approximately $275.0 million.
As we work toward closing and integrating the AccentCare personal care operations, we look forward to growing our network of dedicated caregivers serving the needs of our customers.

Supported by a strong financial foundation, we are excited about the trajectory of our business as we finish out 2026 and look forward to continuing our profitable growth and enhancing shareholder value,” concluded Allison.
Joining the call from the Company will be Dirk Allison, Chairman and CEO, and Brian Poff, Executive Vice President and CFO.
A live broadcast of Addus HomeCare’s conference call will be available under the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website: www.addus.com .
